en-US.author: Shreyam Adhikari
en-US.description: Keyboard-first terminal database workbench and backup agent
en-US.longDescription:
dbterm connects to PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite, Turso, and Cloudflare D1.
Browse accessible databases, query and inspect typed data, operate local services,
and run verified local or remote backups from one cross-platform terminal workbench.
en-US.name: dbterm
